CREATE TABLE "public"."acessoProntuario" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "medicoId" int4 NOT NULL,
  "senhaHash" text NOT NULL,
  "versaoAutorizacao" int4 DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."agendamento" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "data" date NOT NULL,
  "horaFim" text NOT NULL,
  "horaInicio" text NOT NULL,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "medicoId" int4 NOT NULL,
  "pacienteId" int4 NOT NULL,
  "status" text DEFAULT 'PENDENTE' NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "agendamento_status_check_ea658e59" CHECK ("status" IN ('AGENDADA', 'PENDENTE', 'CONFIRMADA', 'REALIZADA', 'RECUSADA', 'CANCELADA', 'FALTOU'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."auditoriaAgenda" (
  "acao" text NOT NULL,
  "agendamentoId" int4,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "dataAgenda" date,
  "disponibilidadeId" int4,
  "horaFim" text,
  "horaInicio" text,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "medicoId" int4,
  "requisicaoId" text,
  "resultado" text NOT NULL,
  "usuarioId" int4,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."auditoriaLogin" (
  "acao" text NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "ip" text,
  "perfil" text,
  "requisicaoId" text,
  "resultado" text NOT NULL,
  "usuarioId" int4,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."auditoriaPaciente" (
  "acao" text NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "medicoId" int4,
  "pacienteId" int4,
  "requisicaoId" text,
  "resultado" text NOT NULL,
  "usuarioId" int4,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."auditoriaProntuario" (
  "acao" text NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "medicoId" int4,
  "pacienteId" int4,
  "prontuarioId" int4,
  "requisicaoId" text,
  "resultado" text NOT NULL,
  "usuarioId" int4,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."codigoPrimeiroAcesso" (
  "codigoHash" text NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "expiraEm" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "tentativas" int4 DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  "usado" bool DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
  "usuarioId" int4 NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."codigoRecuperacaoProntuario" (
  "codigoHash" text NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "expiraEm" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "medicoId" int4 NOT NULL,
  "tentativas" int4 DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  "usado" bool DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."codigoRedefinicaoSenha" (
  "codigo" text NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "expiraEm" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "usado" bool DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
  "usuarioId" int4 NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."disponibilidadeAgenda" (
  "ativo" bool DEFAULT true NOT NULL,
  "data" date NOT NULL,
  "duracaoConsulta" int4 DEFAULT 30 NOT NULL,
  "horaFim" text NOT NULL,
  "horaInicio" text NOT NULL,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "medicoId" int4 NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."medico" (
  "crm" text NOT NULL,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "usuarioId" int4 NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."paciente" (
  "acessoLiberado" bool DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
  "ativo" bool DEFAULT true NOT NULL,
  "cpf" text,
  "email" text,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "medicoId" int4 NOT NULL,
  "nome" text NOT NULL,
  "telefone" text,
  "usuarioId" int4,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."prontuario" (
  "conduta" text,
  "conteudoCriptografado" text,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "exameFisico" text,
  "examesComplementares" text,
  "historiaMolestiaAtual" text,
  "historiaPatologicaPregressa" text,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "medicoId" int4 NOT NULL,
  "pacienteId" int4 NOT NULL,
  "prontuarioAnteriorId" int4,
  "queixaPrincipal" text,
  "versaoChave" int4 DEFAULT 1 NOT NULL,
  "versaoSchema" int4 DEFAULT 1 NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."remarcacaoAgendamento" (
  "agendamentoId" int4 NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "novaData" date NOT NULL,
  "novaHoraFim" text NOT NULL,
  "novaHoraInicio" text NOT NULL,
  "status" text DEFAULT 'PENDENTE' NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "visualizadoPaciente" bool DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "remarcacaoAgendamento_status_check_1b3b9d6e" CHECK ("status" IN ('PENDENTE', 'ACEITA', 'RECUSADA'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."usuario" (
  "ativo" bool DEFAULT true NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "email" text NOT NULL,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "nome" text NOT NULL,
  "primeiroAcesso" bool DEFAULT true NOT NULL,
  "senha" text,
  "tipo" text NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "usuario_tipo_check_bfb6584f" CHECK ("tipo" IN ('ADMIN', 'MEDICO', 'PACIENTE'))
)
